about: What's new in Tabi, newest first. Every release that changes package.json's version adds an entry here in the same pull request (test/changelog.test.mjs checks). Write changes for the people using the app, one short sentence each.

changes: New Ready for Japan card at the top of Settings: it ticks off what this phone needs for the trip, with a button that sets up each thing.
It checks the home screen app, lock-screen notifications, location sharing and your recovery code. A profile photo and offline maps are optional.
Tabi asks once after you sign in, with Remind me later. The card goes away after the trip’s first day.
Trip admins see who’s ready in the Group list, with what’s missing in plain words, and can Nudge someone with a notification.
On small phones, the Show everyone on the map and Wave to everyone buttons in Friends are no longer cut off.
The tabs in Add places scroll all the way to the last one instead of stopping cut off at the edge.
The first and last stop on the map's day card are no longer clipped at its edges.
The Friends card no longer slides sideways on small phones.
The vetoes setting and the day name on the map's day card are no longer cut off on small phones.
Developer console: the Accounts section on the Overview no longer jumps or flickers when the Failover panel above it refreshes.
Developer console: Accounts now keeps itself up to date, changing only the rows of people whose details changed.
Photos, chat pictures and receipts nobody has opened for a while move to cheaper long-term storage, and still open as before.
Every file is checked against a second copy, so a lost or damaged one is fetched from the other store.
The All days button in the itinerary no longer gets cut off at the edge of the screen.
Pull a place card down by its title as well as the little bar at the top.
After pulling a card part way down and letting go, its close button works on the first tap.
The developer console stays steady while live updates arrive: no more flicker, jumping, or text you've typed being cleared.
Tabi now tells you when it has been updated, with a link to what's new.
Settings has a Changelog with the latest updates.
Pinch a picture or GIF in the group chat to open it full screen, then pinch, double-tap or drag to zoom.
Tap a GIF in the chat to open it full screen.
On phones, the app no longer zooms like a web page when you pinch or double-tap. The map still zooms.
Pinch, double-tap and drag to zoom into trip photos and chat photos.
Places on the map glide together when they group and spread out when they split, instead of popping.
New Satellite view in the map layers menu, with aerial photos of Japan under the map's roads and labels.
Buildings show in 3D in dark mode too.
iPhone: turning the phone to landscape and back no longer leaves text too big or taps landing in the wrong place.
Android app: keeps sharing your location while you're standing still, and starts again as soon as you turn sharing on.
Android app: new versions of the app can install in place from Tabi.
